title: Hearing on maternal health in NYC jails
summary: The Council's Women and Gender Equity and Criminal Justice committees held an oversight hearing on maternal health care for pregnant and postpartum people in Department of Correction custody, alongside related bills and resolutions. Topics included mental health protocols for pregnant detainees, a gender-based violence reporting requirement, use of restraints during labor, postponing court proceedings for late-stage pregnancy, and state legislation on postpartum mental illness as a sentencing factor. Data presented showed 52 pregnant people in DOC custody in 2025, all receiving prenatal care, with zero recorded maternal deaths.
